steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Online and social media encompass websites, social networking platforms, blogs, vlogs, wikis, and apps — media products that exist on the internet and often enable audience participation. | Key Fact: Websites use conventions: homepage, navigation menu, banner, content sections, hyperlinks, multimedia (images, video, audio), and calls to action. | Key Fact: Social media platforms (Instagram, TikTok, X/Twitter, YouTube, Snapchat) enable user-generated content, social networking, and algorithmic content distribution. | Key Fact: Prosumer culture: audiences are no longer just consumers — they produce, share, and remix content. This democratises media but also creates challenges with misinformation and quality.
